**Uno – Basic Rules (for a standard 108‑card deck)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or play a pre‑agreed number of rounds). Points are earned by being the first to discard all your cards in each round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). On a turn you may either:
1. **Play** one card from your hand that matches the color, number, or symbol of the top discard card.
2. **Draw** one card from the draw pile if you cannot or choose not to play. If the drawn card can be played immediately, you may do so on the same turn. | | **Card Types** | • **Number cards** (0–9) – match by number or color.
• **Action cards** – match by color or symbol:
 - **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
 - **Reverse** – changes play direction.
 - **Draw Two (+2)** – next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
 - **Wild** – you choose the new color.
 - **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn (must be challenged if you suspect you could have played another card). | | **Playing a Card** | When you play a card, place it on the discard pile and apply its effect immediately. | | **Drawing Cards** | • If you cannot play, draw one card.
• If you draw a playable card, you may play it right away.
• If you still cannot play after drawing, your turn ends. | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you have only one card left, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to call UNO when required results in a penalty: the player who missed it must draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | After a round ends, the winner scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Game End** | Play continues until a player reaches the target score (usually 500). | --- ### Optional Variations | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Some players allow stacking of Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards (e.g., a +2 can be countered with another +2). | | **Challenge Rule** | When a Wild Draw Four is played, the next player may challenge. If the challenger proves the previous player had a playable card, the challenger draws six cards instead of four. | | **Custom Decks** | Uno has many themed decks (e.g., Disney, Marvel). Rules stay the same; just use the appropriate deck type. | --- #### Quick Reference Cheat Sheet | Card | Action | |------|--------| | 0–9 | Match by number or color | | Skip | Next player loses turn | | Reverse | Change play direction | | Draw Two (+2) | Next player draws 2 & loses turn | | Wild | Choose new color | | Wild Draw Four (+4) | Choose new color; next player draws 4 & loses turn (challengeable) | Enjoy playing Uno!
